scripts.wasm: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/ensure-wasm-pack.ps1 && wasm-pack build engine-wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../app/src/engine/pkg --out-name compositor_engine
scripts.wasm:dev: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/ensure-wasm-pack.ps1 && wasm-pack build engine-wasm --target web --dev --out-dir ../app/src/engine/pkg --out-name compositor_engine
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p app/tests/unit && tsc --noEmit -p app/tests/e2e && vite build
